name: Feroz
description: Planeswalker who created the Wizards' School and later vanished.

description_citations.text: "Wizards' School". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the evening Feroz died, the Autumn Willow has a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir.
timeline.quote: On the evening that Feroz died, the Autumn Willow had a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir .

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir meets Serra and Feroz and warns them not to interfere.
timeline.quote: After the arrival of Feroz , the Baron met the two planeswalkers and invited them to his castle.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Feroz's death, Sengir reprimands Serra, who leaves Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: shortly after, Serra left Ulgrotha.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir tells Daria that Serra and Feroz are long dead but their spirit survives.
timeline.quote: "Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."

citation.text: Serra Aviary (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Onatah calls on the song of Feroz, who delivered them.
timeline.quote: "Play the song of he who delivered us. Play the song of Feroz."

citation.text: Didgeridoo (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Feroz comes across Ulgrotha, a plane ruined by the Wizards' Wars.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Feroz came across Ulgrotha , the once-beautiful plane now destroyed by the Wizards' Wars .

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the last unspoiled oasis Feroz meets and marries Serra; together they work to restore the plane and create Feroz's Ban.
timeline.quote: he met fellow planeswalker Serra , whom he married.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a lab accident and the grief-stricken Serra abandons the plane.
timeline.quote: Later, Feroz died during a lab accident, and the grief-stricken Serra abandoned the plane.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir enslaved the Anaba and summoned an earthquake against Feroz, killing many Anaba and destroying the pictoglyph caves.
timeline.quote: Taysir enslaved the Anaba, and many of them were killed when Taysir summoned an earthquake against Feroz, which also destroyed the pictoglyph caves.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz killed Taysir; the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and revived him as an ally two centuries later.
timeline.quote: Feroz eventually killed Taysir, but the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and spent two centuries calming his soul, reviving him as a kind and humble ally.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra falls in love with Feroz and lives with him on Ulgrotha until he is accidentally killed.
timeline.quote: Feroz himself was accidentally killed before her eyes

citation.text: "Serra", section "Living with Feroz on Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacks Sandruu, banishes him to a remote plane, and is killed by Feroz on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: killed him by splitting his skull with a broadsword.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "First death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz arrives and falls in love with Serra; Baron Sengir moves against them; Feroz founds the Wizards' School.
timeline.quote: with whom he quickly fell in love

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha, defeats and exiles him, and is then defeated by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Their duel was won by Taysir, who exiles Sandruu to a remote plane.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Serra cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it from planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: decided to cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it against further despoilment at the hands of strangers

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a laboratory accident and Serra is manipulated by Sengir into leaving the plane; the ban begins to fail.
timeline.quote: Feroz tragically died in a laboratory accident, and Serra was manipulated by Sengir to leave the plane in sadness and guilt

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Ulgrotha Sandruu is banished and Taysir is slain by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Taysir was slain by the guardian of the Homelands, Feroz

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz leaves his people the right to be left alone as his final gift.
timeline.quote: Feroz is gone, but what remains is his final gift to his people: the right to be left alone.

citation.text: Feroz's Ban (Seventh Edition, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Feroz isolates Ulgrotha, giving Autumn Willow sentience; later Feroz's Ban fails and she tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.
timeline.quote: gained sentience after the planeswalker Feroz isolated the plane of Ulgrotha from the rest of the Multiverse

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "Caretaker of the Wood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The first encounter between Feroz, Serra and Baron Sengir took place at An-Havva Inn.
timeline.quote: It was here that the first encounter between Feroz , Serra and Baron Sengir took place.

citation.text: "An-Havva", section "An-Havva Inn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir's arrival banishes Sandruu and destroys the Anaba minotaurs' mural history, prompting Feroz and Serra to act.
timeline.quote: Feroz and his wife Serra decided it was time to do something

citation.text: "Feroz's Ban", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Serra study and labor for nearly a year on Serra's Isle, then on the solstice Feroz casts the Ban, sealing Ulgrotha off.
timeline.quote: Feroz cast a powerful spell, his Ban, that sealed Ulgrotha off from the other planes.

citation.text: "Feroz's Ban", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A wild mana surge during an experiment kills Feroz and the Ban begins to unravel, leaving Ulgrotha prey to planeswalkers again.
timeline.quote: Without its maker, the Ban slowly started to unravel

citation.text: "Feroz's Ban", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz builds the Wizards' School and creates wells of fresh water.
timeline.quote: he built the Wizards' School there and created wells of fresh water

citation.text: "Floating Isle", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz offers to teach the astonished sea dwarves to wield magic in exchange for services.
timeline.quote: he would teach them how to wield magic in exchange for services

citation.text: "Floating Isle", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra and Feroz build a paradise on a small island in the Dead Zone.
timeline.quote: The planeswalkers Serra and Feroz set up their home on a small island far into the Dead Zone

citation.text: "Greater Sea", section "Serra's Isle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra and Feroz work nearly a year to create Feroz's Ban, sealing their world off from other planes.
timeline.quote: This resulted in Feroz's Ban , sealing their world off from the other planes.

citation.text: "Greater Sea", section "Serra's Isle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz builds the Wizards' School on the Floating Island.
timeline.quote: Feroz went to the Floating Island, and with the aid of his magics he built Wizards' School there

citation.text: "Greater Sea", section "Floating Isle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz unearths a didgeridoo that summons Sandruu; they befriend each other.
timeline.quote: the artifact summons Sandruu , an Anaba minotaur , to Feroz

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra appears and kills a Root Spider that tricked and attacked Feroz and Sandruu.
timeline.quote: Serra appears and dispatches the spider

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra and Feroz are invited to dinner by Baron Sengir, who would rather they not disturb Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: they are invited for dinner at Baron Sengir 's place

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir banishes Sandruu but Feroz kills him with a broadsword.
timeline.quote: Feroz kills him by splitting his skull with a broadsword

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra and Feroz erect Feroz's Ban and marry.
timeline.quote: Serra and Feroz erect Feroz's Ban

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "Feroz's Ban". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz is killed by a fire elemental he was studying.
timeline.quote: Feroz is killed by the fire elemental

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "Sengir's Triumph". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz first arrives in the Homelands and meets the latent planeswalker Sandruu.
timeline.quote: It was here that Feroz first arrived in the Homelands, meeting the latent planeswalker Sandruu .

citation.text: "Kher Range", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Taysir duel, and the Anaba pictograph history is destroyed.
timeline.quote: It was also here that the duel between Feroz and Taysir took place

citation.text: "Kher Range", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Serra are married in a minotaur ceremony.
timeline.quote: Feroz and Serra were married in a minotaur ceremony.

citation.text: "Kher Range", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Feroz's death Serra buries him and erects the Monument to Feroz.
timeline.quote: After his death, Serra buried Feroz in a marked grave near the spot where he had first come to Ulgrotha .

citation.text: "Kher Range", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Onatah honors Feroz's legacy through the Didgeridoo and ceremony.
timeline.quote: She revered the Didgeridoo, an instrument symbolic of her people

citation.text: "Onatah", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Feroz's death, Serra failed to save a man from a runaway cartwheel, and Baron Sengir convinced her to leave Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: Baron Sengir appeared and convinced Serra to leave Ulgrotha altogether.

citation.text: "Onella", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Sandruu fight a Root Spider.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Feroz and the Anaba minotaur Sandruu once fought a Root Spider .

citation.text: "Spider", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz builds a great school on the Floating Island, astonishing the returning Sea Dwarves.
timeline.quote: he built a great school there and created wells of fresh water

citation.text: "Wizards' School", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First Master vanishes, leaving magical texts; after chaos a Council of Wizards is formed.
timeline.quote: the First Master vanished, leaving behind a number of his magical texts

citation.text: "Wizards' School", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
